title: Forgotten injective finite-coefficient module sheaves are acyclic for global sections
statement: For a scheme T and level m, and an injective sheaf of modules I over the intrinsic finite coefficient ring sheaf on the pro-etale site of T, the underlying abelian sheaf of I is right acyclic for the global-sections functor (evaluation at the terminal object T).

proof.text: Lift the hom universe of the site by ULiftHom; the induced equivalence of ringed sites preserves injective module sheaves and evaluation at the terminal object. On the lifted site, injective module sheaves have vanishing higher abelian cohomology on every object; identify that cohomology with the right-derived evaluation functor and transport the vanishing back along the sheaf-category equivalence and the derived-functor comparison for an equivalence followed by evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteInjective_sections_acyclic (T : Scheme.{u}) (m : ℕ)
    (I : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      (SemilinearSections.ring.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (SpTowerShriek.B l E T m))) [Injective I] :
    (sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
      (evaluation T.ProEtᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (op (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 T)))).rightAcyclic ((finiteForget l E T m).obj I)
